request: Monthly forecast of Tito's minis in Des Moines for the next 5 months
title: Tito's minis, Des Moines, next 5 months
summary: Tito's minis in Des Moines are forecast at about 30,900 bottles over the next five months, up 7% from the same period last year (28,800). The biggest year-over-year gains are expected in November and January, both up 18%, while September and October look roughly flat. This forecast is built on a ridge model that has been backtested against a simple seasonal-naive baseline and comes out about 8% more accurate overall, though error rates are still fairly high (roughly 37-39% depending on how far ahead you look), so treat the totals as directional rather than precise.

request: What revenue should we expect from Fireball in Linn County next quarter?
title: Fireball revenue, Linn County, next quarter
summary: Fireball revenue in Linn County is forecast at about $554,000 for the next quarter, down 4% from the same three months last year's $578,000. The decline is front-loaded, with September down 11% year over year before November turns positive at +4%. Backtesting shows the model is about 9% more accurate than a simple seasonal-naive baseline across 1-3 month horizons, giving reasonable confidence in the trend, though actual results could still vary from these estimates. No series were skipped or left unvalidated.

request: American vodka sales dollars for each of the five largest counties, next 6 months
title: American Vodka, Top 5 Counties by Population, next 6 months
summary: American vodka sales across the top 5 counties are forecast at about $15.3 million over the next six months, roughly +1% compared to the same months last year's $15.2 million. Monthly performance is mixed, with November standing out at +10% while September and January are down slightly (-2% each). This forecast is about 4% less accurate than a simple seasonal-naive baseline, and accuracy tends to weaken further out, with months 4 and 6 rated worse than baseline, so treat later months with some caution.

request: Forecast ready-to-drink cocktail bottles statewide for the next 6 months
title: Ready-to-drink cocktails, statewide, next 6 months
summary: Statewide ready-to-drink cocktail sales are forecast at about 338,000 bottles over the next six months, down 8% from 368,000 bottles in the same months last year. The steepest declines are expected in October (-16%) and January (-11%), while February is projected roughly flat (+0%). Backtesting shows the model is about 9% more accurate than a simple seasonal-naive baseline, with errors of roughly 10-12% depending on how far ahead the month is, so treat the forecast as directionally reliable but not precise. Only one series, Cocktails/RTD Iowa, was forecast here, with no unvalidated series noted.

request: Total liters of liquor sold statewide over the next 12 months
title: Total liquor sales, statewide, next 12 months
summary: Statewide liquor sales over the next 12 months are forecast at about 22.3 million liters, up +1% versus the same months last year (22.2 million liters). Monthly changes vary, ranging from about -5% to +5%, with early months like September (+3%) and January (+5%) trending up and others like October (-4%) and May (-5%) trending down. In backtesting, this model was about 11% less accurate than a simple seasonal-naive baseline, performing on par in the mid-range months (3-6 months ahead) but noticeably worse in the near term and beyond 6 months, so treat longer-horizon figures with some caution. All products are covered under a single Iowa series, with no unvalidated or skipped series noted.
